name: Padfoot

attributes.attribute: appeared as an omen of death
shaggy and about the size of a donkey

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Padfoot is a beast from English folklore. In Yorkshire, it appeared as an omen of death. It looked like an amorphous shaggy ball with eyes. It also appeared as a woolly white dog. It was about the size of a donkey. Padfoot could become invisible at will. It often roared or rattled to terrify travelers who passed its lair. No one was to strike out at Padfoot. Touching it gave the monster power over you. See also Barguest.

okr.objective: Describe Padfoot, an English death omen from Yorkshire folklore.
key_results: Padfoot was a shaggy omen of death about donkey size in Yorkshire.
It became invisible and terrified travelers by roaring.
Touching Padfoot gave the creature power over the person.
